segments.text: If you use Cursor for daily AI assisted coding, bookmark this immediately. The official cookbook from the Cursor team.
Ready to use recipes, system prompts, and config templates to push the editor to its limits. Step-by-step copypaste MCP templates to securely connect Cursor
to live PostgresSQL databases, REST APIs, and AWS infrastructure right from your AI chat. The ultimate blueprint for the new cursor agent SDK.
